Predicates:
InfectiousDisease(x) ::: x is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(x, y) ::: x is caused by y.
Virus(x) ::: x is a virus.
OccurIn(x, y) ::: x can occur in y.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Symptom(x, y) ::: x has symptom y.
Fever(x) ::: x is fever.
Headache(x) ::: x is headache.
MusclePains(x) ::: x is muscle pains.
FeelingTired(x) ::: x is feeling tired.
Glu(x) ::: x is a glu.
Premises:
InfectiousDisease(monkeypox) ::: Monkeypox is an infectious disease.
CausedBy(monkeypox, monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox is caused by the monkeypox virus.
Virus(monkeypoxVirus) ::: Monkeypox virus is a virus.
OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, Animal) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals.
OccurIn(monkeypoxVirus, Human) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in humans.
Human(Human) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(Mammal) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(monkeypox, Fever) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include fever.
Symptom(monkeypox, Headache) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include headache.
Symptom(monkeypox, MusclePains) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include muscle pains.
Symptom(monkeypox, FeelingTired) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include feeling tired.
Symptom(Human, Glu) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion:
Symptom(monkeypox, Coughing) ::: Symptons of Monkeypox include coughing.
